title: Add explicit benchmark ground truth and actual-versus-expected analysis
objective: Complete the benchmark MVP's validation layer without changing Phase 0–2b semantics: add explicit, operator-authored ground-truth metadata to all 20 benchmark fixtures; validate expected ProgressTrace classifications and baseline outcomes; have the runner produce deterministic actual-versus-expected results and an aggregate summary; add focused tests.
deliverables: All 20 fixtures contain explicit operator-authored ground truth
Ground truth validates expected ProgressTrace classification and baseline behavior
Runner emits actual-versus-expected status per case and aggregate counts
Non-zero failure for malformed metadata or mismatched expected outcome
Focused tests cover all categories, mismatch paths, and determinism
README documents that labels are authored expectations, not semantic truth
non_goals: No changes to Core, existing contracts, CLI, or solution structure
No corpus expansion beyond the existing 20 cases
No human oracle or inter-rater agreement
No production adapter or report UI
No automatic inference of labels from trace text
No LLM judge or external data
stop_conditions: Ground-truth metadata requires a new normative contract outside the benchmark component
Expected outcomes cannot be defined without semantic claims not supported by authored fixture metadata
Two bounded repair attempts are exhausted
